meal.reasoning:
The meal consists of 6 pani puri, a popular Indian street food comprising crispy puri shells filled with spiced water, potatoes, and chickpeas. Nutritional values can vary based on preparation methods and ingredients used. ([caloriesfit.com](https://caloriesfit.com/how-much-calories-in-pani-puri/?utm_source=openai))

**Serving Size and Nutritional Content:**

- **Per Piece:**
  - *Calories:* Approximately 25–40 kcal per piece. ([caloriesfit.com](https://caloriesfit.com/how-much-calories-in-pani-puri/?utm_source=openai))
  - *Carbohydrates:* 5–8 g per piece. ([foods.fatsecret.com](https://foods.fatsecret.com/calories-nutrition/royal/pani-puri?utm_source=openai))
  - *Protein:* 1–2 g per piece. ([foods.fatsecret.com](https://foods.fatsecret.com/calories-nutrition/royal/pani-puri?utm_source=openai))
  - *Fat:* 1–3 g per piece. ([foods.fatsecret.com](https://foods.fatsecret.com/calories-nutrition/royal/pani-puri?utm_source=openai))

- **For 6 Pieces:**
  - *Calories:* Approximately 150–240 kcal.
  - *Carbohydrates:* 30–48 g.
  - *Protein:* 6–12 g.
  - *Fat:* 6–18 g.

**Reasoning:**

- **Meal Description:** The meal consists of 6 pani puri, each typically containing a crispy puri shell filled with spiced water, potatoes, and chickpeas.

For instance, one source estimates approximately 25–40 kcal per piece, while another provides values of 70 calories for 5 pieces (14 g), equating to 14 g per piece. ([caloriesfit.com](https://caloriesfit.com/how-much-calories-in-pani-puri/?utm_source=openai))

- **Serving Size:** A typical serving of pani puri consists of 6 pieces. ([caloriesfit.com](https://caloriesfit.com/how-much-calories-in-pani-puri/?utm_source=openai))
